reviews.reviewer: Three independent visual agents, aggregated by minimum score
reviews.notes: Three independent agents inspected all89 sections across contiguous ranges0–29,30–59,60–88 of the exact final encoded MP4. Dense temporal samples cover the opening, club struggle, handoffs, climax and ending. All reported no delivery blockers. Scores conservatively use the minimum of the three range judgments. This is sampled visual acceptance only; no listening or perfect-sync claim. Evidence: /Volumes/Code/ark-video-studio/output/genesis4-production/review/attempt-02/independent-opening/judgment.json; /Volumes/Code/ark-video-studio/output/genesis4-production/review/attempt-02/independent-middle/judgment.json; /Volumes/Code/ark-video-studio/output/genesis4-production/review/attempt-02/independent-ending/judgment.json

visual.note: An independent agent or person judges decoded visual evidence. Audio/sync can be verified by the separate local machine-measurement gate; a human listening score is not required. Machine verification does not establish artistic excellence.

methods: Decoded mono PCM correlation and lag search across the exact source interval
Independent local Whisper base.en and small.en lyric recognition
Official local wav2vec2 CTC forced alignment with explicit instrumental blank states
Source versus AAC-decoded acoustic alignment stability
Official lyrics: independent base and large wav2vec2 checkpoints with paired onset AND end agreement; transparent ASR lexical disagreement
limitations: Machine evidence assesses content, sample alignment and word boundaries; it does not claim subjective hearing or mathematical perfection.
CTC model is English speech trained; low-confidence sung words fail and trigger bounded retries.
